tex_content.html:
If $\M $ is a Ricci flow with $(r,\de )$-cutoff on a compact manifold and $g(0)$ has positive scalar curvature then the solution goes extinct after a finite time, i.e. $\M _T \: = \: \emptyset $ for some $T > 0$.

Proof

\sketch The curvature and noncollapsing bounds give pointed compactness; Hamilton–Ivey pinching and the surgery estimates identify the smooth limit and preserve the stated properties. ↗ lem:kl-establishing-noncollapsing-presence-surgery-vanishing-noncollapsing

□

Lemma
[compactness for Ricci flow with surgery]
